info.title: Runloom Studio API
info.description: APIs for the Angular host, workflow builder and management application. Verified human Studio access tokens only; machine tokens are rejected. Viewers read authoring resources; editors/admins author and operate workflows. Detailed execution, schedule and audit reads require a role in RUNLOOM_SENSITIVE_RUN_ROLES (admin by default). Organization owners/admins have effective team-admin access. Configured authentication-strength/freshness checks also apply. Workflow operations return X-Runloom-Request-ID audit receipts; a 503 may mean an operation completed but its outcome receipt could not be persisted. Project folders do not grant execution permissions. Try it out sends REAL requests. There is no general run pause/stop/terminate endpoint. Resume targets a designed or budget pause. Studio starts/tests/webhooks have NO durable Idempotency-Key guarantee: do not blindly retry uncertain starts.

get.summary: Read a root and its authorized child graph
get.description: Required access: team viewer/editor/admin. Returns structural outlines and a revision by default. With X-Runloom-Authoring-Context: full, also returns the saved root and authorized reachable child definitions, including prompts, code and input mappings. Does not read credential stores or database connection records. Definition content is sensitive and is sent to the configured model by Lumi. Context is limited to 64 KiB.

parameters.name: X-Runloom-Authoring-Context
parameters.description: Opt in to full authorized definition content on context reads. Older callers remain structural-only.

200.description: Safe structural graph or committed draft-only receipt

400.description: Invalid request or missing explicit approval

409.description: Stale graph or request ID reused with changed content

422.description: Invalid child proposal or resulting graph

423.description: A graph draft has an active editor or write reservation

503.description: Dependency unavailable; retry identical apply request

post.summary: Apply a reviewed child attachment or selected-workflow draft update
post.description: Required access: team editor/admin. Explicit approval and exact graph revision required. Durable request_id binds actor, root and proposal. Replays return the same receipt. Reserves all mutable graph definitions. PostgreSQL or replica-set MongoDB required. Writes drafts, commit history, project assignment and audit atomically. Does not publish or execute. Child version 0 must be explicitly published and pinned before parent execution. With proposal.operation=update and a complete proposal.definition, replaces only the selected root draft while preserving its identity, kind and project. The existing child-attachment shape remains supported. Published snapshots and run histories are unchanged. restore=true restores a prior root draft (including incomplete node configuration) and requires expected_parent_hash, or expected_definition for older receipts. The owner compares the applied draft under the edit reservation before writing; newer saved drafts return 409. Restore writes a new history/audit entry. For fingerprint-anchored retries, request identity excludes the freshly read graph revision, but still binds the actor, root, expected draft and exact restoration content. Receipts include parent_hash for subsequent restoration. Request bodies are bounded to 128 KiB.

post.summary: Save an unfinished draft and create commit
post.description: Required access: team editor/admin. Drafts may be empty or semantically invalid, including missing node configuration, child definitions and prompt references. Valid JSON with recognized field types, schema_version 1.0, a safe workflow ID, 1 MiB size limit, 500 nodes and 10 nesting levels are still required. Layout positions are metadata only. Saving neither publishes nor starts a run. Full validation is mandatory on publication and tests.

get.summary: Search stored team runs and execution tags
get.description: Required access: team membership and configured run-payload read policy (admin by default). Searches all stored runs in the selected team before pagination. Returns newest first, with workflow ID as a descending tie-breaker. Includes runs started by other authorized team callers. Search never examines inputs, outputs or state. Offset pagination is not a frozen snapshot: concurrent inserts/deletes can shift pages; clients should deduplicate by workflow_id or refresh. Missing historical metadata is not synthesized.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of workflow ID, definition ID or an execution metadata value. Maximum 256 UTF-8 bytes.

parameters.name: tag_key
parameters.description: Exact metadata tag filter. Must be supplied together with tag_value; combined with search using AND. Does not broaden team authorization.

parameters.name: tag_value
parameters.description: Case-sensitive exact value, maximum 256 UTF-8 bytes. is_test accepts true or false; definition_version accepts a canonical non-negative integer (0 means draft).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of matching runs to skip. A short page indicates the end of results.

AIDecisionChoice.description: Every AI Decision round requires this structured choice. Handoff requires hitl_required true, nonempty hitl_reason and no actions. Actions/finish require false and an empty hitl_reason. Contradictions fail without dispatching actions. Handoff pauses for operator resume; resume continues after the decision node.
